summary: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust filed an 8-K disclosing conversion price adjustments to its 7.00% Subordinated Convertible Notes due 2031 and results of August 2026 Series D Preferred Stock redemptions. The conversion price was adjusted to approximately $0.40 per share due to the lowest Series D conversion price of $0.73. Seven holders redeemed 7,100 Series D shares at $41.29 each, settled with 403,236 common shares issued. Cumulative redemptions total 1,819,028 Series D shares. The next redemption date is September 2026. Watch for continued dilution and conversion price resets.
